summary: Iteration 7 backend verification — password management endpoints. Added /app/backend/tests/test_password_management.py with 17 new tests covering POST /api/users/me/password, GET /api/admin/users, POST /api/admin/users/reset-password. Full pytest regression: 105/105 PASSED in ~15s (88 previous + 17 new). All acceptance criteria from the review request are verified: self-service change (401 unauth, 400 wrong current, 400 same-as-current, 422 short new, 200 success + old pwd rejected + new pwd logs in); admin list (401 unauth, 403 non-admin, 200 shape {items,page,limit,total}, no password_hash/_id leak, page=2 pagination, q filters by username and by case-insensitive email substring); admin reset (401 unauth, 403 non-admin, 400 own email, 404 unknown email, 422 short password, 200 success + target logs in with new pwd + admin password unchanged). Admin credentials confirmed unchanged at end (login 200). No frontend testing performed — backend-only review request.
critical_code_review_comments: change_my_password (server.py:316-327) correctly re-fetches full user with password_hash (since get_current_user projects it away) and validates current password before comparing new vs current. Order is fine: wrong-current 400 fires before same-as-current 400.

admin_list_users (server.py:330-355) projects out _id and password_hash at the query level — no leak possible. Pagination via skip/limit is correct; sort by email keeps results deterministic. Regex uses $options i for case-insensitive match on both email and username.

admin_reset_password (server.py:358-369) correctly blocks admin resetting own account via id comparison (not email) — robust to email-casing edge cases. Response echoes email+username which is useful for the admin UI to show a toast.

require_system_admin (server.py:200-204) gates by email == ADMIN_EMAIL from env; matches spec and matches how /system/* endpoints are already protected. Non-admin authenticated user gets 403 (not 401) as expected.

Pydantic Field(min_length=6) on new_password produces 422 for short passwords in both endpoints — spec-compliant. EmailStr on AdminResetPasswordIn.email is stricter than raw str: it rejects reserved TLDs like .test (adjusted test to use nowhere.example.com); worth noting in case any legacy test users have exotic emails, but no such users exist in seeds.
Minor pre-existing (non-blocking, previously reported): FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown deprecation warnings — migrate to lifespan in a future cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates ephemeral TEST_pwd_<uuid8> users via /auth/register (function-scoped fixture). Their passwords are mutated (self-change or admin-reset) but users are left in DB — consistent with existing conftest pattern. Admin password NOT modified (verified via post-suite login 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 adds 17 tests in tests/test_password_management.py. Total suite is now 105 tests (~15s with xdist). If future changes touch password fields or admin gating, extend TestChangeOwnPassword / TestAdminListUsers / TestAdminResetPassword classes. Note: AdminResetPasswordIn.email is EmailStr — cannot use .test/.invalid TLDs in tests; use .example.com for 'unknown email' cases.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 12 flow steps from the review request pass end-to-end.
